about: I’m a Data Scientist with 4+ years of experience building production forecasting and analytics solutions across energy and supply chain. I specialize in time-series forecasting, XGBoost-based machine learning, feature engineering, model selection, and hyperparameter optimization, with hands-on experience in Python, PySpark, SQL, and Azure. My work includes electricity load forecasting for ERCOT trading, hedging, and portfolio planning, along with demand forecasting and inventory analytics for more than 2,000 SKUs.

experience.description: Developing production electricity load forecasting and analytics solutions using Python, PySpark, SQL, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Data Factory, and Power BI to support ERCOT energy-market trading, hedging, power procurement, and portfolio planning.

work.description: Developed and supported an end-to-end load forecasting system covering more than 78,000 customer meters and approximately 54 load-profile and weather-zone models across a roughly 220–235 MWh portfolio. Built 50 XGBoost models and four moving-average models, using RFECV for feature selection and Optuna for hyperparameter optimization. Achieved approximately 2–3.5% MAPE for residential profiles and 3–5% for business profiles.
Delivered daily 15-day short-term forecasts and backcasts before 6 AM CST for traders supporting ERCOT energy-market hedging and power-procurement decisions.
Extended the forecasting framework to horizons of up to two years using hourly historical load and weather data, supporting sales, portfolio growth, and business-expansion planning.

work.workname: Weather Data Ingestion and Forecast Monitoring
work.description: Automated weather-data ingestion from REST APIs through Azure Data Factory and integrated weather inputs into model-training and production-inference workflows. Built scalable forecasting workflows and production data outputs using Python, PySpark, SQL, and Azure ML, with Power BI reporting for forecast and model-performance monitoring.

experience.description: Built demand-forecasting, inventory analytics, and management-reporting solutions using SAP HANA, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Databricks, Prophet, moving-average models, and Power BI.

work.description: Built demand-forecasting and inventory analytics solutions for more than 2,000 SKUs using SAP HANA data processed through Azure Synapse and Azure Databricks. Designed a framework using Prophet and moving-average models, with SKU segmentation based on data availability and daily, weekly, and monthly demand statistics. Achieved approximately 15–20% aggregate MAPE.
Produced 15-month demand and inventory outlooks covering stock availability, open orders, backorders, and part-level demand to support recurring management reporting and inventory planning.

work.workname: Automated Reporting and Power BI Dashboards
work.description: Automated data preparation and monthly reporting workflows, including three months of historical views for month-over-month comparison. Developed Power BI dashboards and translated forecasting outputs, inventory KPIs, and data-quality findings into actionable insights for business stakeholders.
